mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, detail, category, priority, due_date, budget_amount, actual_amount, completed) VALUES (#{title}, #{detail}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{budgetAmount}, #{actualAmount}, COALESCE(#{completed}, FALSE))
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, detail = #{detail}, category = #{category}, priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{dueDate}, budget_amount = #{budgetAmount}, actual_amount = #{actualAmount}, completed = #{completed} WHERE id = #{id}
